name: Fox & Fantasy
source:
While exploring a mysterious mountain, you and Tsukiko discover a strange cave. As you venture deeper inside, a brilliant light envelops you, transporting the two of you to an unfamiliar kingdom.

There, you encounter the king, the beautiful swordswoman Katerina, and their companions. They plead with you:

"Heroes, please defeat the Demon King and bring peace to our world. Only then will you be able to return to your own."

Though reluctant, you accept their request and set out on a perilous journey. Can you defeat the Demon King and find your way back home?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.interactive_studio.foxanother]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
在探索一座神秘大山时，你与月子无意间发现了一处奇异的洞窟。随着你们一步步深入洞穴深处，一道耀眼的光芒骤然将两人笼罩，把你们双双传送到了一座陌生的王国。

在那里，你们见到了国王、美丽的女剑士卡特琳娜以及他们的同伴。众人向你们苦苦恳求道：

“勇者大人，恳请你们讨伐魔王，为我们的世界带回和平吧。唯有如此，你们方能重返原来的世界。”

尽管满心不情愿，你们还是应下了这份请求，踏上了危机四伏的征途。你们最终能否击败魔王，找到重返家园的道路？

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.interactive_studio.foxanother]Google Play[/url]]
